corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez for 1 Peter 2:18 is 'ገባር' (servants, plural of ገብር), clearly printed as ገባር on the page.
The printed word is the three-letter 'ሰቦች' (members of the household, translating ገባር); Stage 1 hallucinated an extra ዎ.
Standard Amharic idiomatic pair 'ቀዶ ማልበስን ቆርሶ ማጉረስን' (tearing cloth to clothe, breaking bread to feed); both ቀዶ and ቆርሶ are 7th-order (ሳብዕ) gerunds on the page.
4th-order ፋ was misread as 2nd-order ፉ; the verb is 'ይጽፋሉ' (they write).

corrections.reason: 4th-order ፋ was misread as 2nd-order ፉ in 'ይጽፋል' (he writes).
Amharic citation verb 'አለ' (he said, referring to 'ለእኩያንኒ ላለው'); 1st-order ለ is clearly printed.
4th-order ፋ in 'ግርፋትን' (scourging/flogging) was misread as 2nd-order ፉ.
3rd-person singular 'ሊያጠፋ' (in order for him [the angel] to destroy the Jews); 4th-order ፋ was misread as 2nd-order ፉ.
Classical Ge'ez 'ወኂሩቱ ፡ ለመንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ' (and the goodness of the Holy Spirit); ኂ was misread as ኒ.
